aae0158 refactor: drop the worktree_snapshot_max_file_mb and _max_total_mb inputs, keeping the limits fixed
6e7b23e refactor: only push the snapshots in the always() step, without saving the working tree again
4d4f3e3 refactor: keep only the Snapshot and Skipped trailers, reading the branch and HEAD from the stash
fc7ee89 refactor: let git read stdin and exclude globs, instead of a spawn helper and a glob matcher
74d7fdd refactor: restore only into a clean checkout, so a failed restore just cleans up
bc6a06b refactor: drop the rewind guard, restoring the snapshot the conversation points at
8d0c7ad test: use it.each for the working-tree continuity cases
0358acd fix: stop saving the working tree once the thread closes, and keep the question short
 25 files changed, 2166 insertions(+), 66 deletions(-)
